Cash and USDC are temporarily custodied at Circle for USDC purchases and redemptions. This closes provider/function scope but not position-by-position custody weights, named margin-account entities, USTB look-through custody, legal segregation, rehypothecation or the full fund default waterfall; whole-book custody remains unknown.
